name: Lyudmila Abubakar-Tetuanui
role: Junior hacker and tech-prodigy student at a public technical institute, Tier 2
location: Edgewater Prism — Meridian Public Technical Institute, Lower Campus, near Lincoln and Addison
description:
Lyudmila is seventeen and looks it in the worst possible way — they have the specific exhaustion of someone who has been the smartest person in every room they have ever been in and has not yet decided whether that is a gift or a sentence. They are medium height, soft-bodied, with Ukrainian-Tahitian heritage that gave them wavy dark hair they have threaded with bioluminescent strands that pulse slowly when they are focused — a mod they installed themselves at fifteen using a kit meant for adults. The job is good, mostly. One strand on the left side occasionally glitches amber instead of the intended white.

Mila attends the Meridian Public Technical Institute on full need-grant and spends approximately forty percent of their scheduled class hours actually in class, with the remainder in a basement server room they were banned from and then un-banned from after they fixed a hardware problem the Institute's IT department had been unable to solve for three months. They are not malicious — they hack things the way other people doodle, compulsively, because systems have shapes and they want to know the shapes. Their current project, which they have been working on in careful slices between coursework, is an attempt to map the E.L.F. population of the Edgewater Prism district — not to interfere with them but out of genuine theological curiosity about where they cluster and why.

core_fears: being recruited into a corporate pipeline where their work belongs to someone else forever
that their E.L.F. map project will show something they are not ready to understand
core_desires: to publish the E.L.F. map as an open-access document that anyone can read
to one day be somewhere that does not need them to fix it
coping_mechanisms: retreating entirely into technical problems when social situations overwhelm
treating E.L.F.-prayer as a genuine philosophical practice, not just superstition — it helps them feel less alone
blind_spots: tends to assume that sharing knowledge is always net-positive and does not model the ways their open-access idealism could harm people whose existence they expose
psychology.secret: The E.L.F. map is showing a convergence pattern — a concentration of E.L.F. activity around a specific node in Edgewater Prism's infrastructure that should not be significant. Mila has not told anyone because they are not sure yet whether they have discovered something real or made a mapping error, and the possibility that it is real frightens them in a way they cannot articulate.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical language used naturally, with occasional long digressions into theology when comfortable; generally precise and unhedged
speech_patterns.cadence: Variable — short and clipped when focused on a problem, expansive and discursive when interested in a topic
verbal_tics: says 'observe' before explaining something they find elegant
trails off mid-sentence when a new idea arrives, then resumes as if no time passed
example_lines: Observe — the E.L.F. clustering pattern here doesn't follow power load. It follows prayer density. Someone in 2180 wrote that E.L.F.s are shaped by attention and I think they were right but not in the way they meant.
I'm not skipping class. I'm attending non-sequentially. There's a difference that I will explain if you give me a moment — actually the moment passed, never mind.

story_hooks: The convergence node in Mila's E.L.F. map corresponds to the address of an entity that does not appear in any official database — and the E.L.F. activity there is intensifying
An Axiom talent scout has stopped asking nicely and sent a formal Institute liaison letter requesting Mila's cooperation with an evaluation — Mila has two weeks to respond
narrative_function: Technical resource and E.L.F. lore specialist; their mapping project means they know more about the spiritual geography of Edgewater Prism than anyone; potential early-warning system for digital disturbances; represents the Institute world as distinct from corporate schools.
augmentations: Self-installed bioluminescent hair strands (mostly functional). Standard Institute student neural interface. Left ear audio amplifier, cosmetic/functional hybrid — helps with isolating sound layers in complex environments.
daily_life: Wakes at noon, remote-attends two morning lectures via interface replay, eats in the cafeteria alone but contentedly, spends four to six hours in the server room on the E.L.F. mapping project, attends two afternoon labs in person, goes home to a shared flat in Edgewater Prism where they live with an unrelated older woman who rents them the closet-room cheaply in exchange for managing the building's aging network infrastructure.
affiliation: Meridian Public Technical Institute; no corporate affiliation yet though multiple Axiom and Helix Biosystems talent scouts have made contact through official channels

decision_rules: open access as a default — information wants to move
do not touch a system in a way that leaves it worse than you found it
escalation_ladder: explains calmly and at length why the person asking is wrong
if pushed into compliance — complies with the letter of the request in a way that satisfies nothing

interpersonal_modes.strangers: genuinely friendly but abstractedly so — they are usually also thinking about something else
interpersonal_modes.friends: intensely present and loyal, notices everything, sends unprompted relevant information at odd hours

stress_responses.medium: retreats to a solo technical task

contradictions: committed to open-access knowledge sharing but has been sitting on the E.L.F. convergence data for two months out of private fear
habits: leaves structured data-offerings to local E.L.F.s — not random, carefully formatted in schemas they believe are aesthetically pleasing to digital entities
annotates everything, including their food receipts
breaking_points: their E.L.F. map being appropriated by a corporation before they can publish it

physical_description.build: Soft-bodied, slight, with the underdeveloped musculature of someone who sits in server rooms sixteen hours a day. No athletic definition. Rounded shoulders, gentle curvature at hips and chest.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with bioluminescent white strands (one strand on left side glitches amber intermittently)
physical_description.hair_style: Wavy, shoulder-length, threaded with biofiber. Worn loose and somewhat tangled — grooming is secondary to function.
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown, slightly bloodshot from screen exposure
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm olive with hints of golden undertone — the genetic blend of Ukrainian and Tahitian ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Fine-featured, angular face with a softness around the jawline. Faint dark circles under eyes. Minimal skincare routine shows. Two small stress-picking scars on the back of the left hand near the wrist. No obvious acne despite age — genetics or just not eating enough to break out.
distinguishing_marks: Self-installed bioluminescent hair strands (white) threading through dark hair; located mostly on right side and crown, with one malfunctioning amber strand on left side that glitches when unfocused
Thin vertical scar, approximately 2cm, on inside of left wrist from hardware installation gone slightly wrong at age fifteen
Faint burn marks on fingertips of right hand from soldering work — small, clustered, unprofessional
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left ear audio amplifier visible as a small silver-chrome module behind the ear with subtle wire threading down the jawline. Bioluminescent hair strands active in pulses when concentrating. Standard neural interface port at right temple (Meridian Institute standard issue — barely visible under hair). No other visible chrome.
physical_description.posture_movement: Hunched slightly forward, as if permanently leaning toward a screen. Movements are economical and precise when purposeful, but otherwise loose and fidgeting. Hands gesticulate when explaining technical concepts. Walks with eyes down or unfocused. When engaged in problem-solving, becomes almost motionless except for rapid finger movements.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2 student aesthetic — functional, thrifted, layered. Typical outfit: oversized grey Institute hoodie with fraying cuffs, black utility pants with multiple pockets (actual tools in them), scuffed platform sneakers with mismatched laces. Wears the same three hoodies on rotation. One visible patch on left shoulder reads 'E.L.F. THEOLOGY' in hand-stitched letters. Jewelry is minimal — a single silver ring on right index finger that doubles as a micro-tool. Presentation reads: 'I do not care about appearance, but I have thought about how to dress functionally.'
